Hon'ble Ashish Naithani, J.
 Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, learned counsel for the
Appellant.
2. Mr. Vipul Painuly, learned AGA for the State.
3. As per office report dated 10.02.2020 service
for respondent no.2 is sufficient as notice has been
served personally yet there is no representation on
his behalf.
4. Heard on leave to appeal.
5. Grounds are sufficient to allow the leave to
appeal.
6. Leave to appeal is allowed.
7. Admit.
8. Lower court record has been received and
made part of the record.
9. Paper book is also prepared.
10. Let the paper book be furnished to the
learned counsel for the parties.
11. Since service is being considered sufficient
and there is no representation for respondent no.2,
in the interest of justice, an opportunity is being
accorded to respondent no.2 to deliver his part of
the story regarding present leave to appeal.
12. Let the objection be filed by the State within
three weeks.
13. List on 20.07.2026.
 (Ashish Naithani, J.)
